notes.title: Game experience improved
notes.notes:
[Updates] We've updated the content below at 2022.11.09.

[b]1. Game balance changed[/b]
- After the first 10 games, card decks with various configurations will appear.
- 3 cards difficulty re-balanced.

[b]2. Added skip function[/b]
- After the game result, users can skip the adding experience points scene by just clicking.

[b]3. Bug fixed[/b]
- Fixed achievements were not being processed on macOS.

If you have any requests, don't hesitate to mention them.

Please enjoy our game.

Thank you.
